name: Jareth Thomas
title: Operations, Manufacturing & Skilled Trades Professional
opening: I am writing to express my interest in opportunities where I can contribute my background in operations, warehouse logistics, manufacturing support, and hands-on problem solving. Throughout my career, I have built a reputation for reliability, strong follow-through, and the ability to keep work moving in fast-paced environments.
body: My experience spans steel receiving, production support, inventory control, equipment operation, and residential electrical and repair work. In these roles, I have been trusted to manage incoming materials, maintain accurate documentation, troubleshoot issues on the floor or in the field, and coordinate work so teams can stay productive and on schedule.

Most recently, as Co-Owner of MC Handyman LLC, I have managed scheduling, customer communication, estimating, material sourcing, and project execution from start to finish. That experience strengthened my ability to balance operational priorities, respond quickly to problems, and maintain a high standard of service while working directly with customers and crews.

I would bring a practical work ethic, safety-minded approach, and a willingness to take ownership of whatever needs to get done. I am comfortable learning new systems, supporting team operations, and stepping into roles that require consistency, adaptability, and strong attention to detail.
closing: Thank you for your time and consideration. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background can support your team.
